ios.desc:
Clean up your camera roll by swiping. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep, and watch the storage you free up grow with every photo.

Unroller turns sorting through thousands of photos into something quick, and honestly kind of fun.

START WHEREVER THE MESS IS
- By month: work through your library one month at a time
- By album or category: Screenshots, Live Photos, Favorites, Not in Albums, Random, or your full library
- Largest Files: find the photos and videos that take up the most space

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Live stats while you swipe: photos reviewed, storage freed, how much of your library is done
- Pick up right where you left off

EXTRA TOOLS
- Duplicate Finder and Similar Photos
- Album Cleaner
- Video Compressor
- PDF Creator
- Hidden Photos

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
Unroller processes your library on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded. No ads.

Light and dark mode, available in 23 languages.

FREE AND PRO
Delete up to 15 photos and videos in total for free. Swiping and sorting stay free. Once you have used this allowance, deleting requires Unroller Pro. Pro also unlocks the extra tools and is available as an auto-renewing subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

Built by one developer who reads every email. Questions or ideas: support@unroller.app

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
